changes_from_v1: Fixed the replication run set: clean recurrence_112 seed 17 and seed 99 reruns at batch 64, reuse of the Stage 0 recurrence_112 seed 42 checkpoint, and ff_112 batch-64 controls for seeds 17, 42, and 99.
Added a single-run Stage A stability gate on recurrence_112_seed17_b64 before the remaining four runs.
Fixed the decision metric as the bitwise worst-case AND of PGD-50, APGD-CE 100, and APGD-DLR 100 on the full 5,000-image validation split.
Fixed the primary decision rule: POSITIVE requires min(flagship) > max(ff_b64) and a mean gap of at least +1.0 pp; REVERSED requires max(flagship) < min(ff_b64); otherwise NULL.
Made McNemar a secondary/descriptive test rather than a decision criterion.
Defined the Stage 0 batch-48 ff_112 results as a historical reference only, with a 0.6 pp mean-gap tolerance for reporting a batch/steps effect.
Kept the official ff_112 seed 17 batch-48 model unchanged.
purpose: DRAFT ONLY. No run has been launched. This file records the design for a matched-recipe replication of the Stage 0 recurrent-vs-feedforward comparison at 112 px, with the no-run Stage A gate and the fixed decision rule.
question: Does the recurrent flagship beat feedforward at 112 px under a matched recipe, after accounting for the two confounds found after the Stage 0 verdict (batch 48 vs 64; contaminated flagship seed 17)?

confounds_addressed.description: Stage 0 trained ff_112 at loader batch 48 (2,639 steps/epoch, 39,585 steps over 15 epochs) and recurrence_112 at loader batch 64 (1,979 steps/epoch, 29,685 steps). The replication trains every arm at batch 64.

The Stage 0 recurrence_112 seed 17 final checkpoint has an AdamW step counter of 21,762, consistent with a fresh optimizer from epoch 5 (11 x 1,979 = 21,769), not 15 continuous epochs. The local epoch-4 rolling checkpoint has five parameter groups and zero optimizer state entries. The replication reruns seed 17 under the empty-state guard.

stage_a.description: Stability gate. Run only recurrence_112_seed17_b64 first and evaluate its worst-case accuracy on the full 5k split before spending compute on the remaining four runs.
stage_a.stop_rule: If stop_if triggers, do not run Stage B and report: "flagship unstable at this recipe; NULL stands; Stage B not run". Otherwise continue. The 35.44 pp figure is the lowest existing Stage 0 ff_112 batch-48 seed and is recorded as a descriptive reference only; it is not a gate.

descriptive_reference.note: Lowest existing Stage 0 ff_112 batch-48 seed; shown for context only.

stage_b.description: Remaining four matched-batch-64 runs. Launch only if Stage A does not trigger its stop rule.

existing_flagship_seed42.description: Stage 0 recurrence_112 seed 42 was trained at batch 64, has a continuous optimizer history (29,668 steps vs 15 x 1,979 = 29,685), and had no observed reset. Reuse it rather than retrain it.

data.augmentation: RandomResizedCrop(112, scale 0.35-1.0), horizontal flip, ImageNet normalization

optimization.scheduler: 3-epoch linear warmup then cosine decay, stepped once per epoch

adversarial.curriculum: constant across epochs; epsilon and TRADES weights do not change with epoch

recipe.checkpoint_policy: final epoch only; no selection on validation or evaluation images

evaluation.battery: Stage 0 canonical harness: clean + PGD-50 + APGD-CE + APGD-DLR at eps = 5.417/255
evaluation.slice: full 5,000-image ImageNet-100 validation split; the 1k canonical slice is not used for the decision
evaluation.worst_case: bitwise AND of PGD-50, APGD-CE, APGD-DLR correctness arrays
evaluation.per_sample_artifacts: one .npz per arm with per-sample correctness arrays

analysis.primary: Compare recurrent and feedforward worst-case robust accuracy on the full 5k surface at matched batch 64.
analysis.per_seed: Report clean, PGD-50, APGD-CE, APGD-DLR, and worst-case for every seed.
analysis.decision_metric: worst-case accuracy = mean of the bitwise AND of PGD-50, APGD-CE, and APGD-DLR correctness arrays on the full 5,000-image split

decision_rule.POSITIVE: min(flagship worst-case over seeds 17, 42, 99) > max(ff_b64 worst-case over seeds 17, 42, 99) AND mean(flagship worst-case) - mean(ff_b64 worst-case) >= +1.0 pp
decision_rule.NULL: all other outcomes, including any non-strict tie or a mean gap below +1.0 pp

analysis.mcnemar: Pooled McNemar exact two-sided test on discordant pairs is secondary and descriptive; it does not change the decision.
analysis.selection: No checkpoint selection; evaluate the epoch-15 final checkpoint only.

batch_reference.rule: Report the Stage 0 batch-48 ff_112 seeds as historical reference only. If mean(ff_b64) differs from 35.79 pp by more than 0.6 pp, report that the batch/steps change affected the feedforward baseline. Do not change the decision rule or verdict.

analysis.official_model_unchanged: The official ff_112 seed 17 batch-48 model is not retrained, replaced, or re-selected by this replication.
